name: heaven-agent-control
description: Operate the user's heaven2-hosted MHW programming-agent control plane from ChatGPT while delegating heavy execution to heaven.

interface.shortDescription: Operate MHW Agent Control on heaven2
interface.longDescription: Operate the MHW agent swarm from heaven2, the operator/control-plane machine. Use Heaven Local Bridge with target_host=heaven2 for controller startup, CLI/status, dashboards, control interactions, and other human-facing operations. Delegate heavy builds, tests, scans, indexing, and worker agents to heaven without relocating the control plane.
defaultPrompt: Show me the current MHW agent swarm from Agent Control on heaven2.
Deploy one support agent from heaven2 and let Agent Control route heavy execution to heaven when appropriate.
Keep all control panels and interaction on heaven2 while using heaven only as a worker resource.
